sentences.en: In today's astronomy lecture, I'm going to talk about the need for a system to manage the movement of satellites and other objects in orbit around the Earth.
sentences.zh: 在今天的天文学讲座中，我将讨论建立一套系统来管理地球轨道上卫星及其他物体运行的必要性。

sentences.en: In other words, a Space Traffic Management system.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，就是空间交通管理系统。

sentences.en: We already have effective Air Traffic Control systems that are used internationally to ensure that planes navigate our skies safely.
sentences.zh: 我们目前已经拥有行之有效的空中交通管制系统，该系统在国际范围内使用，以确保飞机安全地在我们的天空中航行。

sentences.en: Well, Space Traffic Management is a similar concept, but focusing on the control of satellites.
sentences.zh: 那么，空间交通管理是一个类似的概念，但其关注点在于对卫星的管控。

sentences.en: The aim of such a system would be to prevent the danger of collisions in space between the objects in orbit around the Earth.
sentences.zh: 此类系统的目的是防止地球轨道上的物体之间发生碰撞的危险。

sentences.en: In order to do this, we'd need to have a set of legal measures.
sentences.zh: 为实现这一目标，我们需要制定一系列法律措施。

sentences.en: and we'd also have to develop the technical systems to enable us to prevent such accidents.
sentences.zh: 同时，我们还必须开发技术系统，以帮助我们预防此类事故。

sentences.en: But unfortunately, at present we don't actually have a Space Traffic Management system that works.
sentences.zh: 但遗憾的是，目前我们实际上并没有一个真正有效运转的空间交通管理系统。

sentences.en: So why not?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么没有呢？

sentences.en: What are the problems in developing such a system?
sentences.zh: 开发这样一套系统存在哪些问题？

sentences.en: Well, for one thing, satellites are relatively cheap these days, compared with how they were in the past, meaning that more people can afford to put them into space.
sentences.zh: 首先，如今卫星的成本相较于过去已大幅降低，这意味着更多人能够负担得起将卫星送入太空的费用。

sentences.en: So there's a lot more of them out there, and people aren't just launching single satellites but whole constellations, consisting of thousands of them designed to work together.
sentences.zh: 因此，太空中卫星的数量急剧增加；人们发射的不再只是单颗卫星，而是一整个星座——由数千颗协同工作的卫星组成。

sentences.en: So space is getting more crowded every day.
sentences.zh: 因此，太空正日益变得拥挤。

sentences.en: But in spite of this, one thing you may be surprised to learn is that you can launch a satellite into space and, once it's out there, it doesn't have to send back any information to Earth to allow its identification.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，有一件事或许会让你感到惊讶：你可以将一颗卫星发射到太空中，而一旦它进入轨道，就无需向地球回传任何信息以供识别。

sentences.en: So while we have international systems for ensuring we know where the planes in our skies are, and to prevent them from colliding with one another, when it comes to the safety of satellites, at present we don't have anything like enough proper ways.
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然我们已有国际系统来确保掌握天空中飞机的位置，并防止它们相互碰撞，但在卫星安全方面，目前我们却远不具备足够完善的手段。

sentences.en: of tracking them.
sentences.zh: 来追踪它们。

sentences.en: it And it isn't just entire satellites that we need to consider.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们不仅需要考虑完整的卫星。

sentences.en: A greater threat is the huge amount of space debris in orbit around the Earth - broken bits of satellite and junk from space stations and so on.
sentences.zh: 更大的威胁是环绕地球轨道运行的大量太空碎片——包括破损的卫星残骸、空间站遗弃的垃圾等等。

sentences.en: And some of these are so small that they can be very hard to identify, but they can still be very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 其中一些碎片体积极小，极难被识别，但即便如此，它们仍可能造成严重危害。

sentences.en: In addition, some operators may be unwilling to share information about the satellites they've launched.
sentences.zh: 此外，部分运营商可能不愿共享其发射卫星的相关信息。

sentences.en: For example, a satellite may be designed for military purposes, or it may have been launched for commercial reasons, and the operators don't want competitors to have information about it.
sentences.zh: 例如，某颗卫星可能是为军事目的设计的，或出于商业原因发射，而运营商并不希望竞争对手获取有关它的信息。

sentences.en: And even if the operators are willing to provide it, the information isn't easy to collect.
sentences.zh: 即使运营商愿意提供信息，收集这些信息本身也并非易事。

sentences.en: Details are needed about the object itself, as well as about its location at a particular time - and remember that a satellite isn't very big, and it's likely to be moving at thousands of kilometres an hour.
sentences.zh: 我们需要掌握物体本身的具体信息，以及它在特定时刻所处的位置——请记住，卫星体积很小，且很可能正以每小时数千公里的速度高速运行。

sentences.en: We don't have any sensors that can constantly follow something moving so fast, so all that the scientists can do is to put forward a prediction concerning where the satellite is heading next.
sentences.zh: 我们目前没有任何传感器能够持续追踪如此高速运动的物体，因此科学家们所能做的，仅仅是预测该卫星下一步将飞往何处。

sentences.en: So those are some of the problems that we're facing.
sentences.zh: 以上便是我们当前面临的一些问题。

sentences.en: Let's consider now some of the solutions that have been suggested.
sentences.zh: 现在让我们探讨一下已被提出的若干解决方案。

sentences.en: One key issue is the way in which information is dealt with.
sentences.zh: 其中一个关键问题是信息的处理方式。

sentences.en: We need more information, but it also needs to be accessible at a global level, so we need to establish shared standards that we can all agree on for the way in which this information is presented.
sentences.zh: 我们需要更多数据，同时这些数据还需在全球层面实现共享，因此我们必须确立统一标准，以便各方就信息呈现方式达成共识。

sentences.en: We already do this in other areas of science, so although this is a challenge, it's not an impossible task.
sentences.zh: 我们在其他科学领域已经这样做了，因此尽管这是一项挑战，但绝非不可能完成的任务。

sentences.en: Then, as all this information's collected, it needs to be put together so it can be used, and that will involve creating a single database on which it can be entered.
sentences.zh: 接着，在收集所有这些信息后，还需将其整合起来加以利用，而这将涉及构建一个单一数据库，用以录入全部信息。

sentences.en: As we continue to push forward new developments, congestion of the space environment is only going to increase.
sentences.zh: 随着我们持续推进新技术发展，太空环境的拥堵状况只会愈发加剧。

sentences.en: To cope with this, we need to develop a system like the one I've described to coordinate the work of the numerous spacecraft operators, but it's also essential that this system is one that establishes trust in the people that use it, both nationally and at a global level.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局面，我们需要建立如我前述那样的系统，以协调众多航天器运营商的工作；但同样至关重要的是，该系统必须能在国家及全球层面赢得使用者的信任。

sentences.en: One interesting development ...
sentences.zh: 一项有趣的进展……
